shared_elements: bird with prominent beak in profile
small human figure with raised arm
horizontal banded registers on a tall upright slab
justification: Both surfaces are tall upright slabs carved in low relief with content organised into stacked horizontal bands, and both include profile animals, beaked birds and small human figures, plus a disc-like element near the top. But A shows a few large, isolated, boldly schematic animals with no scene-binding relationships, while B is dominated by dense rows of miniature repeated signs beneath a winged disc and an adoration-style figure register, so the specific forms, scale conventions and relations between elements differ almost entirely.
